## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

**VFX import reconciliation — Combo-Fighters repo ↔ ZM roadmap (audit run 2026-02-28, V. Barnes)**

Context: reconciling the claim that the Combo-Fighters "art import" PR is fully covered by the merged VFX branch and can be parked. Findings below so the next person sees the real state.

**Owner attribution (important — 3 different "Marcus" identities):**
- GitHub art/VFX author "Marcus" = commits authored as **marcus@harmonygames.co** (contact "Marcus", no last name, external/contract artist — NOT a company user). This is who did the Combo-Fighters art/VFX imports.
- **Marcus Bennett** (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co, internal) = files the ART VFX tickets (creator of this ticket). Different person.
- **Marcus Lee** (marcus.lee@harmonygames.co) = third Marcus, no involvement found in this work.
Reviewer/merger on nearly all art PRs = Oliver Brooks (oliver.brooks@). Backend = "Blake" (arthur blake).

**Code state (Combo-Fighters, PRs since Dec 2025):**
- Real VFX imports that MERGED: #7 ElectricVfx, #16 WinScreen_CoinVfx, #33 Tiles Combo Highlight (→develop), #36 "vfx updates" bloom/material fix (→ **playable only**). Plus art PRs #3/#5/#6/#11/#12/#13/#22/#27. VFX artifacts confirmed present in repo (Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab, FightGame_Volume_High bloom volume, shaders).
- The umbrella draft PR #1 (Marcus/ImportingArtAssets → main) has **0 files changed**, label "do not merge", and only an automated CodeRabbit comment — no human review, no unique code. It is an empty shell; the actual work went through the individual PRs, not through #1.
- Two attempts to reconcile the import branch with develop (PR #10, PR #32) were **closed without merging** → import branch diverged, never cleanly reconciled.
- Default branch `main` is **267 commits behind** the active `playable` line; #36's recent VFX/material fix lives only on `playable`. If a build is cut from `main`, that VFX is not in it.
- No unresolved human review pushback found on the VFX PRs — but only because they were merged with NO human review (CodeRabbit even auto-skipped #36 as it targeted a non-default branch). QA gap, not a clean bill of health.

**Roadmap cross-check:** ZM ROADMAP card "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" is marked due-complete, yet both checklist items ("Marcus to create VFX", "Engineer to implement") are still **incomplete**. That specific VFX was not delivered by the import.

**Bottom line:** the empty draft PR #1 is safe to close/park (no code to lose), but "the import is fully covered / done" is NOT supported: recent VFX is stranded on `playable`, the import branch was never reconciled to develop/main, and at least one roadmap VFX item remains genuinely unfinished. Needs: (1) confirm which branch ships and that #36 is on it, (2) formally close PR #1, (3) finish/close the item-infusion VFX.

WHY THIS EXISTS

I checked the code and the roadmap directly before signing off, because last time we took an art-import status on someone's word we shipped placeholders. Here is the real state.

THE THREE "MARCUS" PROBLEM (get attribution right)
- GitHub art/VFX author "Marcus" = commits authored as marcus@harmonygames.co — the EXTERNAL/contract artist (contact has no last name, not a company user). This is who did the Combo-Fighters imports.
- Marcus Bennett (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co) = INTERNAL artist who files the Linear ART VFX tickets. Different person.
- Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@harmonygames.co) = third Marcus, no involvement in this work.

WHAT ACTUALLY MERGED (real VFX imports)
- #7 ElectricVfx (electric beam/generator) — merged
- #16 WinScreen_CoinVfx — merged
- #33 Tiles Combo Highlight (combo highlight VFX system, shaders) — merged to develop
- #36 "vfx updates" (bloom post-processing + material fix) — merged to the PLAYABLE branch only
- Plus art imports #3, #5, #6, #11, #12, #13, #22, #27 (animations, models, backgrounds, enemies, shadows)
Artifacts confirmed present in the repo: Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab, FightGame_Volume_High (bloom volume), shaders. So real VFX did land — piecemeal, through these individual PRs.

WHAT IS THE DRAFT "IMPORT PR" (#1)
- PR #1 "Marcus/importing art assets" (Marcus/ImportingArtAssets -> main) is an EMPTY shell: 0 files changed, labeled "do not merge", only an automated CodeRabbit comment, no human review.
- There is no unique code sitting in PR #1. The actual work went in through the separate PRs above, not through #1. So closing/parking PR #1 loses nothing — this part of Marcus's claim holds.

WHAT IS STILL OPEN (why "covered/done" is an overstatement)
1. The most recent VFX (#36 bloom/material fix, Feb 11) is only on the `playable` branch. The default branch `main` is ~267 commits BEHIND playable. If a build is cut from `main`, that VFX is not in it. Confirm which branch ships.

Roadmap cross-check: ZM ROADMAP card "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" is marked due-complete, but BOTH checklist items — "Marcus to create VFX" and "Engineer to implement" — are still incomplete. That specific VFX was not delivered by the import (a June-2025 "1 day, almost done" note never landed).

"No pushback" here means "nobody reviewed," not "reviewed and clean" — the exact gap that let placeholders slip before. (No placeholder-art red flags found on main this time, for what it's worth.)

But **"already covered by the merged VFX branch / done" is an overstatement**, and these are the gaps that would burn you the same way the placeholder build did:

That specific VFX was not delivered by the import.

- **GitHub art/VFX author "Marcus" = commits as `marcus@harmonygames.co`** — an external/contract artist (contact has no last name, not a company user). This is who did the Combo-Fighters imports.

- **Marcus Lee** (`marcus.lee@`) — third Marcus, no involvement here.

Worth confirming which Marcus told Leonard it was covered.
